title: Concept Vector Atlas for AI Safety-Relevant Behaviors

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: A comprehensive atlas would directly enable safety teams to prioritize which behaviors are steerable. Clear impact chain from resource to adoption.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Extracting 20+ concept vectors across three model families requires significant ML engineering and compute. Each extraction involves contrastive pair design, which requires domain expertise. Far too broad for beginners in 30 hours.

narrow_scope.reasoning: 20+ concepts across three model families is a massive scope. Even with the extraction pipeline automated, designing contrastive pairs for 20 safety concepts and running them on 3 models is a multi-month project, not a 30-hour one.
